name.ja: 吉草酸エストラジオール

role.zh: 雌二醇的戊酸酯前体，口服片或油剂注射；进入体内水解为雌二醇。中文圈最常见的雌激素制剂（补佳乐）
role.en: Valerate ester prodrug of estradiol, as oral tablets or oil injection; hydrolysed to estradiol in vivo. The most common estrogen product in Chinese-speaking communities (Progynova)

equivalence.zh: 按分子量换算：2 mg 戊酸雌二醇 ≈ 1.53 mg 雌二醇
equivalence.en: Molar equivalence: 2 mg estradiol valerate ≈ 1.53 mg estradiol

name.ja: エストラジオール（微粉化錠）

role.zh: 非酯化的雌二醇本体（半水合物）压片，可整片吞服或舌下含服；Estrofem / Estrace 属此类
role.en: Non-esterified estradiol (hemihydrate) tablets, swallowed or used sublingually; Estrofem / Estrace belong here

equivalence.zh: 标示量即雌二醇本体含量（2 mg 片 = 2 mg 雌二醇）
equivalence.en: Labelled strength is estradiol itself (a 2 mg tablet = 2 mg estradiol)

name.ja: エストラジオール経皮パッチ

role.zh: 经皮持续释放雌二醇，规格以每 24 小时释放量（µg/24h）标示；分每周一换与每周两换两类
role.en: Continuous transdermal estradiol; strength labelled as µg released per 24 h; once-weekly and twice-weekly products exist

equivalence.zh: 贴片标示的是释放速率而非含量：同为 100 µg/24h 的不同品牌，贴片内雌二醇总量可能不同
equivalence.en: Patches are labelled by release rate, not content: two 100 µg/24h products may contain different total estradiol

name.ja: エストラジオールゲル／スプレー

role.zh: 经皮涂抹或喷洒的雌二醇制剂；泵装、单剂量小袋与定量喷雾三种包装
role.en: Transdermal estradiol applied to skin; supplied as metered pumps, single-dose sachets or metered sprays

equivalence.zh: 泵装凝胶按「每泵含量」计：Oestrogel 每泵 1.25 g 含 0.75 mg 雌二醇
equivalence.en: Pump gels are dosed per actuation: Oestrogel delivers 1.25 g gel = 0.75 mg estradiol per pump

name.ja: シピオン酸エストラジオール

role.zh: 长效油剂注射用雌二醇酯，主要在美国上市（Depo-Estradiol）
role.en: Long-acting oil-based injectable estradiol ester, marketed mainly in the US (Depo-Estradiol)

equivalence.zh: 按分子量换算：5 mg 环戊丙酸雌二醇 ≈ 3.4 mg 雌二醇
equivalence.en: Molar equivalence: 5 mg estradiol cypionate ≈ 3.4 mg estradiol

name.ja: エナント酸エストラジオール

role.zh: 仅存在于拉丁美洲的每月一次复方避孕针（与藻苯酮二羟孕酮合用），无单方制剂
role.en: Exists only in Latin-American once-monthly combined contraceptive injections (with dihydroxyprogesterone acetophenide); no single-agent product

equivalence.zh: 按分子量换算：10 mg 庚酸雌二醇 ≈ 7.1 mg 雌二醇
equivalence.en: Molar equivalence: 10 mg estradiol enanthate ≈ 7.1 mg estradiol

name.ja: ウンデシル酸エストラジオール

role.zh: 超长效雌二醇酯，历史上用于前列腺癌；商品制剂已全球停产
role.en: Very long-acting estradiol ester historically used for prostate cancer; commercial products discontinued worldwide

equivalence.zh: 按分子量换算：100 mg 十一酸雌二醇 ≈ 62 mg 雌二醇
equivalence.en: Molar equivalence: 100 mg estradiol undecylate ≈ 62 mg estradiol

name.zh: 戊酸雌二醇 / 炔诺孕酮（序贯复方）
name.ja: 吉草酸エストラジオール／ノルゲストレル配合

role.zh: 更年期序贯激素治疗复方（克龄蒙）；同一盒内白色片仅含戊酸雌二醇，浅棕色片另含炔诺孕酮。中国大陆常见，易与补佳乐混淆
role.en: Sequential menopausal HRT combination (Cyclo-Progynova); white tablets contain estradiol valerate only, light-brown tablets add norgestrel. Common in mainland China and easily confused with Progynova

reason.zh: 炔诺孕酮是 19-去甲睾酮类孕激素，具雄激素活性；该复方为更年期设计，不是跨性别 HRT 的标准选择
reason.en: Norgestrel is a 19-nortestosterone progestin with androgenic activity; the product is designed for menopause and is not a standard choice in transgender HRT

name.zh: 雌二醇 / 地屈孕酮（序贯复方）
name.ja: エストラジオール／ジドロゲステロン配合

role.zh: 更年期序贯激素治疗复方（芬吗通）；前半盒仅含雌二醇，后半盒另含地屈孕酮 10 mg
role.en: Sequential menopausal HRT combination (Femoston); first half of the pack is estradiol only, second half adds dydrogesterone 10 mg

reason.zh: 成分本身站内均有收录，但配比与周期为更年期设计，固定剂量不可拆分调整；不是跨性别 HRT 的标准选择
reason.en: Both components are covered on this site, but the fixed ratio and cycle are designed for menopause and cannot be adjusted; not a standard choice in transgender HRT

role.zh: 甾体类抗雄激素，兼具孕激素活性；中国大陆无单方制剂上市（仅存在于达英-35 复方），常见版本来自台湾、德国与印度
role.en: Steroidal antiandrogen with progestogenic activity; no single-agent product in mainland China (only in the Diane-35 combination) — common versions come from Taiwan, Germany and India

role.zh: 保钾利尿剂，兼有抗雄激素受体作用；中国大陆与美国最易获取的抗雄药物
role.en: Potassium-sparing diuretic with androgen-receptor antagonism; the most accessible antiandrogen in mainland China and the US

role.zh: 非甾体雄激素受体拮抗剂，原为前列腺癌用药；日本上市规格为 80 mg，其他市场为 50 mg / 150 mg
role.en: Non-steroidal androgen-receptor antagonist originally for prostate cancer; Japan markets an 80 mg strength, elsewhere 50 mg / 150 mg

role.zh: 第一代非甾体抗雄激素，需每日多次服药
role.en: First-generation non-steroidal antiandrogen requiring multiple daily doses

reason.zh: 肝毒性风险显著高于比卡鲁胺，主要指南不推荐用于跨性别 HRT
reason.en: Substantially higher hepatotoxicity than bicalutamide; not recommended for transgender HRT by major guidelines

role.zh: 长效 GnRH 激动剂缓释注射剂，1 / 3 / 6 个月剂型；中国大陆有国产（贝依）与进口（抑那通）
role.en: Long-acting GnRH agonist depot injection in 1-, 3- and 6-month forms; mainland China has both a domestic (贝依) and an imported (抑那通) product

role.zh: GnRH 激动剂，皮下植入固体缓释棒（1 / 3 个月），需较粗针头由医护操作
role.en: GnRH agonist delivered as a solid subcutaneous depot rod (1- or 3-month) via a wide-bore needle; clinician-administered

role.zh: GnRH 激动剂缓释注射剂（1 / 3 / 6 个月）；欧洲跨性别青少年阻断剂常用
role.en: GnRH agonist depot injection (1-, 3-, 6-month); commonly used as a puberty blocker in Europe

role.zh: 唯一有鼻喷剂型的 GnRH 激动剂，按说明书每日多次喷鼻；另有皮下注射液；供应有限
role.en: The only GnRH agonist available as a nasal spray (dosed several times daily per label); an injectable also exists; limited supply

role.zh: 12 个月皮下植入棒，需小手术置入与更换；美国青春期阻断常用
role.en: 12-month subcutaneous implant requiring minor surgery to place and replace; used for puberty blocking in the US

role.zh: 鼻喷 GnRH 激动剂，原用于子宫内膜异位症与中枢性性早熟
role.en: Nasal-spray GnRH agonist originally for endometriosis and central precocious puberty

role.zh: GnRH 拮抗剂注射剂，起效快、无激动剂的初期「点火」效应；前列腺癌适应症
role.en: Injectable GnRH antagonist with rapid onset and no agonist flare; prostate-cancer indication

role.zh: 口服 GnRH 拮抗剂（每日一片），前列腺癌（120 mg）与子宫肌瘤（40 mg，日本）适应症
role.en: Oral GnRH antagonist (one tablet daily); indications are prostate cancer (120 mg) and uterine fibroids (40 mg, Japan)

name.zh: 黄体酮（微粉化 / 注射）

role.zh: 生物同源孕激素；口服软胶囊、阴道制剂与油剂注射三类。软胶囊多为花生油基质，花生过敏者注意
role.en: Bioidentical progestogen; oral softgels, vaginal products and oil injection. Most softgels use arachis (peanut) oil — check if peanut-allergic

name.ja: ヒドロキシプロゲステロンカプロン酸エステル

role.zh: 每周一次的油剂注射用孕激素；美国 Makena 已于 2023 年撤市
role.en: Weekly oil-based injectable progestogen; US product Makena was withdrawn in 2023

role.zh: 逆转型孕酮衍生物，口服生物利用度高于微粉化黄体酮、无镇静作用；中国大陆有进口（达芙通）
role.en: Retro-progesterone derivative with better oral bioavailability than micronized progesterone and no sedation; imported into mainland China (Duphaston)

role.zh: 螺内酯衍生的孕激素，兼抗盐皮质激素与抗雄活性；单方制剂（Slynd / Slinda）不含炔雌醇，与优思明等复方避孕药不同
role.en: Spironolactone-derived progestogen with antimineralocorticoid and antiandrogenic activity; single-agent products (Slynd / Slinda) contain no ethinylestradiol, unlike Yasmin-type combined pills

name.ja: 酢酸メドロキシプロゲステロン

role.zh: 合成孕激素，口服片与长效避孕针（Depo-Provera）；中国大陆常见（安宫黄体酮）
role.en: Synthetic progestin as oral tablets and a long-acting contraceptive injection (Depo-Provera); common in mainland China

reason.zh: WHI 研究中与结合雌激素合用时乳腺癌与心血管风险升高；WPATH 等指南不建议作为跨性别 HRT 的孕激素首选
reason.en: Associated with higher breast-cancer and cardiovascular risk when combined with conjugated estrogens in WHI; not recommended as first-choice progestogen in transgender HRT by WPATH and others

role.zh: 19-去甲睾酮类合成孕激素，用于月经调节与避孕；体内部分代谢为炔雌醇
role.en: 19-nortestosterone progestin used for cycle control and contraception; partly metabolised to ethinylestradiol in vivo

reason.zh: 具雄激素活性且部分代谢为炔雌醇，不是跨性别 HRT 的孕激素选择
reason.en: Androgenic and partly metabolised to ethinylestradiol; not a progestogen choice for transgender HRT

role.zh: II 型 5α-还原酶抑制剂；1 mg 规格用于脱发，5 mg 规格用于前列腺增生，两者为同一分子
role.en: Type II 5α-reductase inhibitor; 1 mg for hair loss and 5 mg for BPH are the same molecule

equivalence.zh: 1 mg（脱发适应症）与 5 mg（前列腺适应症）片仅剂量不同
equivalence.en: The 1 mg (hair-loss) and 5 mg (prostate) tablets differ only in dose

role.zh: I/II 型双重 5α-还原酶抑制剂，软胶囊剂型；半衰期长达数周
role.en: Dual type I/II 5α-reductase inhibitor in softgel form; half-life of several weeks

name.zh: 炔雌醇复方（复方口服避孕药）
name.ja: エチニルエストラジオール配合剤

role.zh: 所有复方口服避孕药的雌激素成分都是炔雌醇（EE）；达英-35、优思明等在中国大陆极常见，曾被误用作 HRT
role.en: Ethinylestradiol (EE) is the estrogen in every combined oral contraceptive; Diane-35, Yasmin etc. are common in mainland China and have been misused as HRT

reason.zh: 炔雌醇的静脉血栓风险是生物同源雌二醇的数倍，且常规血检无法监测其水平；主要指南一致不用于跨性别 HRT
reason.en: Ethinylestradiol carries several-fold higher venous-thrombosis risk than bioidentical estradiol and cannot be monitored by routine blood tests; major guidelines uniformly exclude it from transgender HRT

role.zh: 从孕马尿提取的雌激素混合物（倍美力），主要成分为雌酮硫酸酯与马烯雌酮
role.en: Estrogen mixture extracted from pregnant-mare urine (Premarin), mainly estrone sulfate and equilin

reason.zh: 含马源雌激素，标准雌二醇血检无法准确监测；WHI 研究显示心血管与血栓风险高于经皮雌二醇
reason.en: Contains equine estrogens not captured by standard estradiol assays; WHI data show higher cardiovascular and thrombotic risk than transdermal estradiol

role.zh: 弱效短效雌激素，主要作为局部阴道制剂或更年期低剂量口服片使用
role.en: Weak, short-acting estrogen used mainly as local vaginal products or low-dose menopausal tablets

reason.zh: 受体活性弱、作用时间短，不能替代雌二醇达到女性化所需的雌激素水平；偶被当作「E」误售
reason.en: Weak receptor activity and short action; cannot replace estradiol for feminisation, and is occasionally mis-sold as "E"

description.en: Small white round sugar-coated tablet, about 5 mm
